properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): limitation 18 is the 2026-08-15 class, still open. The schema is checked only when an edge is written: validate_edge has one caller, the store's create_edge. Opening a store, export_graph and detect_defects never re-check stored edges. Each narrowing ships its migration by hand for the pairs its census saw. reflow2's own committed export imports cleanly on 0.77.0, and its CI already re-imports and round-trips that export
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triaging art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, limitation 18. Triage agent C, dev_reflow2 hub.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words: "An edge written under an older version stays in the store and in every export, and only --import applies the current rule, refusing the whole file ... an export can be unloadable by the binary that wrote it. Containment: re-import committed exports into a scratch store in CI."

② PRECEDENT: ALREADY RECORDED, twice, and not re-minted here.
- The class: fact:defect-a-schema-narrowing-orphaned-live-edges-and-no-export-is-ever-imported (2026-08-15, dev_storyflow VERIFIES).
- The instance: fact:a-store-keeps-an-edge-a-newer-schema-refuses-and-its-export-cannot-be-imported-2026-10-01 (musicjug REALIZES→Decision, 0.75.0).
- The corpus idea: dec:idea-what-regression-corpus-guards-the-upgrade-path and cap:todays-binary-reads-exports-taken-at-past-releases (planned).

⑤ MEASURED, reflow2-mcp 0.77.0. Log: /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-C/measure.log.
(1) main's own export (origin/main 66620f7, docs/design/reflow2.json, 27.6 MB, stamped 0.77.0) imports cleanly into a scratch store: 6,309 nodes and 41,546 edges, exit 0, 4.4 s. Not every export is unloadable; a long-lived store minted under an older release is the exposed case.
(2) A hand-built export holding REALIZES Artifact→Decision and VERIFIES Verification→Decision was refused by import_graph and by CLI --import. Both offenders were listed, NOTHING was written, and the REALIZES line names the fitting edge (DOCUMENTS). The VERIFIES line names none. The CLI --import still left an empty store directory behind.
(3) THE CONTAINMENT THE REPORT PROPOSES ALREADY RUNS for reflow2 itself. ci.yml "Design coherence gate" runs tools/reflow2_check.py --export docs/design/reflow2.json. That script --imports the export into a temp graph (die 2 on refusal), then check_round_trip re-exports it and compares. Consumers get it only by opting in through the ci-gate skill. It cannot see a store that was never exported, or an export nobody committed, and musicjug's was neither.

③④ CODE, origin/main:
- The schema's validate_edge is called only from foundation/store/engine/edges.rs, on write. Its one other caller is a service.rs helper over the vocabulary.
- core export.rs export_graph does not validate.
- heal.rs detect_defects has no detector for a stored edge the schema now refuses.
- Opening a store runs three HAND-WRITTEN migrations: AUTHORED_BY roles, REALIZES onto a check becomes IMPLEMENTS, and the stored-twin repair.
- Import adds the same REALIZES→Verification rewrite, reported as migrated_edges.

⑥ THE CLASS: a narrowing is a migration nobody is made to write. Each tightening carries its own repair for the pairs its author's census found. The census reads committed exports on one machine: ver:a-file-realizes-only-what-it-implements records "in-memory imports of the six other committed designs". Nothing re-checks a store after the binary changes. So the first reader of the new rule is the next import, usually a move or a second contributor's first store.

UNDER MCP: identical. export_graph, import_graph and detect_defects are the same handlers.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED:
- export_graph and detect_defects were not measured on a LIVE store holding a refused edge. No binary on this box predates a narrowing that would let one be written (the oldest is 0.74.0, and no edge endpoint narrowed between 0.74.0 and 0.77.0). Their behaviour above is read from code.
- Whether 0.75.0's silence on export (measured 2026-10-01) still holds is inferred, not re-measured.
